english:
Disabled in the Crucible.

Stowing your weapon while Built Bitter is active starts Critical Health Regeneration and restores HP based on the amount of damage taken.

Healing can inconsistently be much higher.

source.text:
4 Piece | Bittersweet
>>DISABLED IN CRUCIBLE<< 

On Weapon Stow, while Built Bitter stacks are active.
Begins Critical Health Regeneration.
Restores Health based on the amount of damage taken.
Do note there are some weird inconsistencies that can result in MUCH higher healing values.
